engine-oil-dipstick-assembly.summary: The guide brings the flexible indicator from an accessible handle down into the sump. The seated stop fixes how far the indicator extends; the guide and calibrated marks must match the engine and oil pan.
engine-oil-dipstick-assembly.limits: This study connects the guide, blade and support hardware using inferred dimensions and adjacent-year mounting evidence. The blade has no verified ADD/FULL marks. Its flexed shape is a display pose, and the exploded view does not simulate bending or withdrawal.

steps.title: Follow the indicator
steps.text: Use See through covers to reveal the continuous strip inside the guide. The free lower end extends into the sump.

steps.title: Locate the seated stop
steps.text: The handle's stop meets the guide mouth, giving the strip a repeatable axial position. Actual friction retention and oil calibration remain unresolved.

steps.title: Find the shared support
steps.text: The upper bracket attaches to a retainer that also clamps the side cover. That retainer stays in the side-cover assembly because it is one physical part serving both systems.

troubleshooting.title: Treat tube and indicator as a matched set
troubleshooting.text: A changed guide route, stop position or indicator length changes where the marks sit in the sump. This uncalibrated model cannot supply a correct oil-level reading.
